theorems.name: Submission.rsdic_imrep_action_int_combination
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ R : IMRep U n) (p₁ p₂ : ℤ), (∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ) • R.orient y) x = (p₁ : ℝ) • R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x + (p₂ : ℝ) • R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = (p₁ : ℝ) * R₁.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) + (p₂ : ℝ) * R₂.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
